title: Backrooms: The Lost Circus
description:
Backrooms: The Lost Circus is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players that carefully integrates elements of Backrooms, offering a unique take on this mysterious dimension rather than a direct mirror image of a familiar concept. 

Key Features: >Fresh Perspective 
This isn't your typical backrooms experience. It's a unique interpretation that sets it apart from the ordinary.

>One life
And no indulgences!

>Co-op
Supports up to 4 players simultaneously. or solo only

>Stealth
Sounds will attract something... better use it

>Proximity Voice Chat
You can scream with your friends, but there is one thing...

>Immersive AI
AI's behavior is utterly unpredictable. Even I can't anticipate its next move.
description_short: Backrooms: The Lost Circus is a Co-op horror game up to 4 players, where you and your friends will explore the game, try to pass the game level using your mind, wit, remembering the places where you were
